backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister defining an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report describing implemented features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing high‑level summaries of various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Defines global CSS variables and theme tokens for a color system using OKLCH values, with light and dark mode.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML page that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up routing with TanStack Router and defines routes for home, options, checkout, and confirmation pages.
frontend/src/components/DiamondIcon.tsx: Simple component rendering a styled diamond character icon.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the current identity, with query invalidation on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity login, state management, and context provider logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file exporting nothing, reserved for future backend queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and gray‑purple theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/mgp.ts: Provides MGP ID validation and an error‑message helper enforcing the 'mgp-' + digits format.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entrypoint that initializes React, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout form collecting shipping and payment details and generating a random arrival date before navigating to order confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/Gen4ElcOptions.tsx: Displays Gen 4 model options with MGP ID validation and routes users to checkout based on selection.
frontend/src/pages/Gen5Options.tsx: Shows Gen 5 pre‑order options with MGP ID validation and navigates to checkout for selected models.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page linking to Gen 4 and Gen 5 options with simple navigation UI.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmation.tsx: Displays order confirmation details using query params and offers navigation back to home.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, containers, and utilities with plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Defines the project's current state, required UI/theme updates, new Gen 5 features, pricing, navigation flows, and Mgp ID validation rules. Also records architectural notes and previously implemented features.
